Allah turns away from His signs the arrogant, who take the way of error; the deeds of those who deny His signs and the meeting of the Hereafter are worthless.
Those who do not believe in the Hereafter are arrogant; they call the revelation legends of former peoples and will bear their own burdens and some of those they misguide.
Some dispute about Allah without knowledge, guidance or scripture, twisting away in arrogance to mislead; they face disgrace in this world and the Burning Fire on the Day of Resurrection.
Quraysh and the Arabs swore a warner would make them better guided than any nation, yet when one came their aversion grew, through arrogance and evil plotting.
Those who dispute Allah's signs without any authority have only pride in their breasts that they will never attain, so seek refuge in Allah, the Hearing, the Seeing.
Man transgresses when he sees himself self-sufficient, yet to his Lord is the return.
